children: Centrus Energy signed a multi-year contract to supply HALEU to Antares, with deliveries to begin before the end of the decade.
Signed definitive multi-year contract to supply high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) to Antares.
Deliveries under the agreement are scheduled to commence prior to the end of the current decade.
Contract includes prepayments from Antares to support expanded domestic HALEU enrichment capacity.
Supplies are U.S.-origin and “unobligated,” enabling support for national security and space missions.
Adds another HALEU customer to Centrus' backlog and supports its commercial-scale expansion at Piketon.
